title: ChatGPT in everyday life

body.text: ChatGPT helps with all kinds of everyday tasks, like
planning trips, writing to-do lists, finding recipes, or prepping for a job interview
. Think of something that takes you time, then try letting ChatGPT help — you'll save a lot of it.

example: "Plan a 3-day, 2-night trip to Chiang Mai, budget 5,000 baht for 2 people, focused on nature and local food."

title: Build a ChatGPT habit

body.text: use it every day on the real tasks you run into
— drafting emails, finding gift ideas, or learning something new. The more you use it, the better you get at writing prompts that deliver the result you want.

example: "I need to send a report to my boss today — proofread this email to be formal and concise before I send it: [paste the email]"
